responsibility: Implements miscellaneous front-end-wide utilities that do not belong to a narrower subsystem, with emphasis on diagnostics, classification, and parser-support helpers that depend on GCC headers. It provides message and internal-error routines, symbol/type/operator stringification, assorted semantic helpers, filename/line bookkeeping support, and large reserved/context-sensitive COBOL word tables used to classify source text and support parsing and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Provides the actual miscellaneous utility implementations, especially diagnostics, stringification helpers, and reserved/context-sensitive word tables. The corresponding header is much narrower and only declares a small shared subset of those utilities.
